page.layout: One column of entries, with a Hebrew running head at the top centre and the page number at the top right; a catchword at the foot right.

main_text.l: מָקוֹם c. Locus: plur. masc. מְקוֹמוֹת.
אֵלְקוֹם Invictus, contra quem nemo insurgit.
קִינָה f. Lamentatio: plur. קינוֹת & קִינִים.
הִקּוֹפָּרָה f. Conversio, Revolutio: plurale, תְּקוּפוֹת.
קוּץ Tædere, Distædere; Semel est Æstivare, Æstatem transfigere, Jesa.18.6. Hiphil הִקְיִיץ Tædio adficere: Expergisci.
קוּצוֹת f. p. Capilli, à Succidendo dicti, quasi à קָצַץ.
קוֹר Fodere, Effodere. Hiphil הִקִּיר Manare, Erutare, ut fons vel scaturigo aquam.
קוּשׁ Tendiculam ponere: convenit cum יָקֹשׁ.

page.notes: Hebrew entries are at the left edge of each line and are copied as far as legible; the vowel points in several words are uncertain and may not match the print exactly. The left edge of the scan is cut, so some initial letters may be lost, for example the first letters of lines 2, 5, 9 and 17. The catchword at the foot right is set apart from the entries.
